title: Threshold conflicts with removing controllers
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, attack vector to capture the wallet  **Likelihood:** Medium, relevant not for all sets of controllers  ## Description  There is a drawback to using absolute weights - sometimes we should decrease the Threshold before removing a controller. Decreasing Threshold is a strong voting rules adjustment, and can be maliciously used by any controller.  Imagine we have a set of controllers A=50, B=50. TotalWeight=100, Threshold=100.
